We need to extract explicit facts.

Text: "Little Rock River

The Little Rock River is a tributary of the Rock River, long, in southwestern Minnesota and northwestern Iowa in the United States. Via the Rock, Big Sioux and Missouri rivers, it is part of the watershed of the Mississippi River."

We need to parse.

Entities: Little Rock River (subject). Relation: tributary of -> Rock River. Also location: southwestern Minnesota and northwestern Iowa in the United States. So we can have two location statements: "Little Rock River" "located in" "southwestern Minnesota" and "located in" "northwestern Iowa". Also "located in" "United States"? Might be combined. Usually we can have "place of location" qualifiers.

Also "Long" is ambiguous: "long" maybe length but not given numeric. Could be attribute "length" but no value. Probably ignore.

Third sentence: "Via the Rock, Big Sioux and Missouri rivers, it is part of the watershed of the Mississippi River." So relation: "part of watershed" -> "Mississippi River". Could also include qualifiers: "via" indicates path through Rock, Big Sioux, Missouri rivers. Might treat as qualifier "via" with objects? But we have qualifier types: maybe "via" not defined. Could use "qualifier relation": "via" but not in allowed list. The allowed qualifiers include point in time, place, role, polarity, modality, attribution, condition, unit, approximation. "via" is not among them. So we might just state the relation without qualifiers: "Little Rock River" "part of watershed" "Mississippi River". Could also add "through" but not needed.

Also we could have "Little Rock River" "located in" "United States". But we have more specific states.

We need subject_type and object_type. For rivers: subject_type "river". object_type for tributary relation: "river". For location: object_type "region" or "state". Use "state" maybe. For "United States": "country". For watershed: object_type "river". Could be "river basin". We'll choose "river".

Now produce JSON.

2. Little Rock River - located in - southwestern Minnesota. qualifiers none. subject_type "river", object_type "region". Could be "state". Use "state". southwestern Minnesota is a region within Minnesota; type "region". We'll use "region".

3. Little Rock River - located in - northwestern Iowa. same.

4. Little Rock River - located in - United States. maybe include. But maybe redundant. Could include.

5. Little Rock River - part of watershed - Mississippi River. qualifiers none. subject_type "river", object_type "river".

Potentially also "Rock River" is tributary of? Not needed.
